description.text: The fifth enhanced expansion pack of the Sword & Shield series, released on 28 May 2021 and built around Eevee's evolutions. All eight appear as Pokémon V, and Leafeon, Glaceon, Sylveon and Umbreon also as Pokémon VMAX. Each of these Pokémon V also came in two full-art Super Rare versions, the second drawn as a full scene, and each Pokémon VMAX in two Hyper Rare versions, one rainbow and one drawn as a full scene. Eevee itself, whose attack takes up to three Pokémon V from the deck, joins them. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 69, followed by the Super Rare Pokémon V and the Supporters Aroma Lady and Gordie, the Hyper Rare cards, and gold Ultra Rare Inteleon, Boost Shake, Turffield Stadium and Darkness Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Evolving Skies in August 2021 and Fusion Strike in November 2021.
